summary: Require explicit LLM completion contracts before closing tickets

delivery.outcome: Require an explicit analytical response contract or existing source-edit contract before any LLM execution/claim; prevent narrative-only replies from closing implementation tickets. Independently publish and deploy the exact reviewed queue guard.
nonGoals: No changes to non-LLM executors, patch transaction authority or publication policy
No automatic closure of previously misclassified tasks

architecture.decision: Reuse inputs.expect_files_changed=false as the explicit answer-delivery declaration and existing patch/refactor/code-change contracts for material edits. Reject absent or incorrectly typed declarations before claim, model invocation and done; retain accepted edit verification and deterministic wait state.
architecture.rollback: Restore the exact prior protected runtime; preserve task notes, evidence and lease history.
